result: Set within the fictional, dystopian city-state of Khansaar, Salaar: Part 1 – Ceasefire brings to light a story centered around the deep friendship between two men. Deva, a local tribesman, shares a strong bond with Varadha, the prince of Khansaar. Their connection remains steadfast as dangerous events begin to threaten the stability of the entire region.

The situation escalates dramatically when a treasonous coup d'état is set into motion against the ruling authority. Plotted by Varadha's father's ministers and a group of his own relatives, the takeover attempt seeks to seize control of the city-state. Driven to defend his claim, Prince Varadha enlists Deva's help, seeking his friend's support to defeat the conspirators and ultimately become the undisputed ruler of Khansaar.
